# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_profile_photo (Data Source)

The profile photo of a WhatsApp phone number's business profile.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number` (String) The phone number.

### Read-Only

- `phone_number_id` (String) Meta phone number ID
- `profile_photo_url` (String) URL of the business profile photo (served by Meta's CDN). May be empty if no photo is set.
- `record_type` (String)
